approval_end_consistent.name: approval_end_consistent
approval_end_consistent.value: ("approval"."status" = 'granted' AND "approval"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "approval"."ended_by_id" IS NULL AND "approval"."end_reason" IS NULL) OR ("approval"."status" <> 'granted' AND "approval"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL)

decision_source_context.name: decision_source_context
decision_source_context.value: ("decision"."revision_id" IS NULL OR "decision"."proposal_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("decision"."source_thread_id" IS NULL OR "decision"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL)

delivery_external_synced_identity.name: delivery_external_synced_identity
delivery_external_synced_identity.value: "delivery_external_link"."status" <> 'synced' OR ("delivery_external_link"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "delivery_external_link"."synced_at" IS NOT NULL)

readiness_completion_consistent.name: readiness_completion_consistent
readiness_completion_consistent.value: ("readiness_check"."status" IN ('pending', 'running') AND "readiness_check"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("readiness_check"."status" IN ('passed', 'failed', 'error', 'skipped') AND "readiness_check"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

review_assignment_one_target.name: review_assignment_one_target
review_assignment_one_target.value: ("review_assignment"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("review_assignment"."group_id" IS NOT NULL)

suggestion_resolution_consistent.name: suggestion_resolution_consistent
suggestion_resolution_consistent.value: ("suggestion"."status" = 'pending' AND "suggestion"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "suggestion"."resolved_by_id" IS NULL AND "suggestion"."accepted_revision_id" IS NULL) OR ("suggestion"."status" = 'rejected' AND "suggestion"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."resolved_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."accepted_revision_id" IS NULL) OR ("suggestion"."status" = 'accepted' AND "suggestion"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."resolved_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."accepted_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."accepted_revision_id" <> "suggestion"."revision_id")

thread_resolution_consistent.name: thread_resolution_consistent
thread_resolution_consistent.value: ("thread"."status" = 'open' AND "thread"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "thread"."resolved_by_id" IS NULL) OR ("thread"."status" = 'resolved' AND "thread"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "thread"."resolved_by_id" IS NOT NULL)
